description:
## Appreciation of works
### 5、KṣaṇaCha-Deep Dive into tea
The packaging of "Deep Dive into tea" is inspired by the traditional Chinese 'Lu Ban Lock' and the 'inch of brocade game' on the tea table, where each small package has a picture on the waistband.

## 7、EFUTON "ten consecutive championships" jenga tea
### 8、PUYU Instant Tea Package Design
It breaks the traditional single-shape packaging for instant drinks and uses the concept of the product as a whole for visual interpretation: the overall colour scheme of the packaging corresponds to the different flavours of tea, giving the whole 'landscape' a layered look and reflecting the changing seasons.

## ![Chun Feng Shi Yang Ju](https://static.foodtalks.cn/image/post/22d1709ce5304c60715e7361826cee9d.jpg)
The packaging colors are mainly selected from traditional Chinese colors, using bright contrasting colors and more fashionable image processing methods.

### 12、CHALI BLACK LABEL OOLONG TEA
It adopts an italic clamshell structure, and the tea bag is placed in a gradient shape at the bottom of the gift box at a slope angle.

### 13、WILLchá
In order to better implement the concept of "light", the overall packaging does not use adhesive technology and there is no plastic lamination on the box, the tea label of the bag is printed with edible grade soy ink technology and the bag is sealed with ultrasonic, with no glue, which is safe and healthy.

### 16、The collection of health tea named CONGQIANMAN
The support of the leather-like material in the inner bag opens up a packaging experience from "cold" to "warm". The innovative outer box tumbler design allows the entire tea package to be easily attached to a home or office water dispenser, transforming the box into a slim and textured tea bin drawer that can be easily opened and closed to take tea.
